title: Berserk: The Eclipse
alt: A great funnel of dark red air that turns about a black sun with a ring of pale fire. The walls of the funnel are faces without number, each with hollow eyes and an open mouth, small and bright near the sun, large and dark at the edges of the picture. A hand as great as a hill stands up in the middle, with its palm toward us and the black sun over its fingers. On the ends of the four fingers stand four very small dark figures: a tall one with a great round head, one with wings, a small one that floats, and one that is low and round. In the middle of the palm kneels a very small pale figure with long white hair, seen from behind. The long shade of each finger lies across the palm.
summary: A painting of the Eclipse from Berserk in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the Eclipse, from Berserk, a manga by Kentaro Miura. Griffith led the Band of the Hawk, and he has lost everything. The sun goes black, and he and all his people are in a place that is not in the world.
A great hand lifts him up to the four members of the God Hand, who stand on the ends of its fingers. They wait for the words that give his friends to them. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
